🚀 Martin Wandera here, driven by a passion for transforming data into actionable insights and optimizing data infrastructures. attributes.role: Data Engineer, Generative AI, Machine Learning Trainee
attributes.summary:
- Built and maintained data pipelines using Kafka, Airflow, dbt, PostgreSQL to efficiently process and transform large-scale datasets for machine learning tasks.
- Designed and implemented generative AI models using LLMs and transformers, generating text intended for the user with a focus on creativity and accuracy.
-  Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) and feature engineering to improve model performance and optimize data pipelines.

Dedicated eight months to working on the Arena mobile app, a social media app for schools.
- Conducted user interviews and surveys to understand user needs for a new mobile app.
- Created wire-frames, prototypes, and mock-ups to iterate on the app's design.
- Collaborated with back-end developers to implement responsive and user-friendly interfaces.
